reason: Reviewed all five surfaces for the release channel command. `notifai channel` shows the saved channel offline; `notifai channel stable|beta` saves it, installs a newer release on that channel at once, and otherwise keeps the active build, so leaving beta keeps a newer beta until a newer stable release replaces it. Notifai skill: the updates reference now names `notifai channel` for a User-chosen channel change and keeps `notifai update --channel stable --allow-downgrade` as the explicit return to the older stable release; the release note says the same. CLI readiness: plain `notifai update` on a kept beta now reports that nothing newer is available instead of a downgrade refusal; `update --check` output is unchanged. Lifecycle hooks: unchanged; automatic updates still never switch channels and now drop a beta staged before the switch to stable. Harness setup and domain terms: unchanged.
